keywords: EIP-8037 的双资源计量 gas 方程
EIP-8070 依 ACDC #172 列为 CFI
summary: aelowsson 为 EIP-8037 提出双资源计量 gas 方程，回应提高状态创建成本可能挤占常规 gas、妨碍扩容的担忧。nixorokish 依 ACDC #172 的决定把 EIP-8070 从 PFI 改为 CFI 并合并。weiihann 提交临时合约存储 EIP。

items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8037 的双资源计量 gas 方程
items.note: （aelowsson）03:49：EIP-8037 统一并提高状态创建 gas，担忧在于用户把更多 gas limit 花在状态创建上会挤占常规使用，文章给出把两种资源分开计量的方程。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Two-resource metered-gas equations for EIP-8037
items.note_en: (aelowsson), 03:49: EIP-8037 harmonizes and raises state creation gas, and the concern is that users spending more of the gas limit on state creation crowd out regular use, so the post gives equations that meter the two resources separately.

keywords_en: Two resource metered gas equations for EIP-8037
EIP-8070 moved to CFI per ACDC #172
summary_en: aelowsson proposed two resource metered gas equations for EIP-8037, answering the concern that pricier state creation crowds out regular gas and slows scaling. nixorokish moved EIP-8070 from PFI to CFI per the ACDC #172 decision, merged. weiihann submitted a temporary contract storage EIP.
